'''Zeetara Maan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the decade preceding the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|char=1}}

A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Zeetara Maan was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Studying at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] as an [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]], Maan ascended to the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the reemergence of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Assigned to a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] to continue training, Maan constructed a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to wield throughout her career.<ref name="KSW" />

In response to the Sith's reappearance the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] opened several [[Jedi outpost/Legends|Jedi outposts]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for supplemental group training. Assigning Padawan Maan to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the High Council placed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] in command of her and a number of other students to travel to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld aboard a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]]. Upon the group's arrival, the students were greeted by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] the [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Watchman]] of Kashyyyk, along with Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The Padawans settled in at the new [[Jedi outpost (Kashyyyk)|chapter house]] and quickly began classes, continuing on their path to knowledge.<ref name="KSW" />

During Maan's time on the planet, the armies of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], combined with [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], [[Kashyyyk Trade Rebellion|attacked]] the planet and the Wookiee village near the chapter house. Rallying behind Masters Yoda and Zane, the apprentices repelled the Trandoshans with few casualties. Following Master Yoda's departure, the students were attacked again. This time, Master Zane and several students were captured while the chapter house and most of the apprentices were killed. Maan, among the survivors, eventually found herself above [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] on a Commerce Guild [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. After the Padawans and Zane were freed from captivity, the Jedi escaped aboard the ''[[Star Runner]]'' and made an emergency landing on the planet below. Joining [[Mak Pra]] and the [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] resistance movement, Maan and her companions attempted to capture Commerce Guild [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] and prevent her from attacking Coruscant with [[trihexalon]] missiles. Thwarted in their initial attempts, the Jedi rushed to Coruscant and smashed the Commerce Guild's fleet, ending the crisis and saving Coruscant. Upon Maan's return to the Jedi Temple, Master Zane elevated her to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] before the assembled members of the Temple's [[Jedi academy|academy]].
